answer: An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 5 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Since the relic hash is stored at intake, the juniper graph groups the endorsements and the gale audit shows the collapse. An operator copying one text across 54 aliases as a result burns for 54 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, since the hash is the same for all of them. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
